title: Forge seat record v2
description: v1's vocabulary (decision 0034) plus the two facts decision 0035 ruled missing: the effort configured for the model, and the reasoning it spent. v1 is not edited; this is a new file beside it, and a record is validated against the version its run's engine wrote. Everything v1 said still holds: it is an accounting record, never a transcript, and no prompt, response, reasoning text, command, tool arguments, tool results, diff, or other prose field is admitted. input_tokens includes cache reads; cache_read_tokens is its reported subset and must never be added to input_tokens again by a view. reasoning_output_tokens is the same kind of fact one level down — a reported subset of output_tokens, never a second addend, absent (never zero, never back-filled from a run total) where a harness reports no per-turn figure. effort is CONFIGURATION, not a report: it is the harness's own echo of the setting applied after every profile and plugin layer, and it is never read back from the bundle's pin. Numeric accounting is omitted when unreported and, when present, is strictly greater than zero. Historical journals remain readable: model, transcript and effort are optional in the schema because no record-version marker distinguishes rows written before decisions 0031, 0032 and 0035; current built-in completeness is enforced by driver conformance.

model.description: The harness-reported served model, never a configured pin. The only non-provider values are the two sentinels ruled by decision 0031. It is the provider's claim, not proof (decision 0035 ruling 2): no harness discloses quantization, hardware routing, or a substitution made at peak load, and the same string comes back whichever happened.

effort.description: The effort configured for the model, as the harness echoes it back (decision 0035 ruling 3). CONFIGURATION, never a report: no harness discloses a served effort, so this is the setting that applied after every profile and plugin layer — read from the harness's own echo, never from the bundle's pin, and never presented as a measurement of what the model did. A harness whose lanes carry a real effort control but echo no value writes decision 0031's 'not reported'; a driver with no model turn writes 'not applicable'. The two sentinels are reused rather than reinvented, and the distinction between them is load-bearing: a control that exists but goes unreported is not a control that does not exist.

transcript.description: Decision 0032's retained, harness-owned locator. It carries an id or path and never transcript content.

input_tokens.description: All reported input tokens, inclusive of cache_read_tokens.

output_tokens.description: All reported output tokens, inclusive of reasoning_output_tokens.

cache_read_tokens.description: The cache-read subset of input_tokens; never a second addend.

cache_write_tokens.description: Tokens the harness reports as written to or created in its cache.

reasoning_output_tokens.description: The reasoning subset of output_tokens, in the way cache_read_tokens is a subset of input_tokens; never a second addend. The three harnesses report it at different granularities and this field admits all three without inventing the others. Where a harness reports no figure for this record the field is ABSENT — never zero, and never back-filled from a run total.

tool.description: A bounded harness tool identifier, never its arguments or command.

target.description: A bounded file-path-only target for the tool call; never a command, URL, tool argument object, or prose.

result.description: A successful typed phase result plus the seat record reported beside it. result, inputs, and notes are phase-machine/report fields, not permission for harness prose in accounting fields.
